summary: Version 0.17.0 is live (release ddf1bd5b3ede, CI green, scanner reloaded with 50 stocks and the Nov 20 signals, no file refused). The portfolio page opens on a TODAY checklist: three morning items (read the orders; placed, skipped on purpose with a reason, or none planned; a stop for each position), two evening items (no trade outside the plan; read the evening analysis), a mood and a note, one save button, no JavaScript. /journal has one row per trading day since the simulation started, newest first, missed days included and highlighted, with the streak, the best streak, assiduity over 30 days and overall, and gaps between the plan and the owner's real orders computed from the ledger. Only today and the trading day before can be saved. Entries live on the server in /data/results/discipline. The owner approved the screenshots before release. The evening run reads the checklist status and mentions it in one line.
delivered: scan/discipline.py: Entry (3 morning items, 2 evening items, mood, note), Store (one file a day), trading_days (market holidays skipped once a later session exists), gaps_of (outside the plan, above the advised size, a sale of shares not bought here), journal (statuses, streak, best, assiduity, gaps), from_form (only today and the trading day before, never a weekend).
_today.html.j2 at the top of /portfolio and POST /discipline; journal.html.j2 at /journal; sign-out links on the pages.
GET /api/upload/discipline (Bearer): the day's status without the note, for the evening run; ROUTINE.md step 10; the session cron prompt updated.
tests/test_discipline.py (statuses, streaks, assiduity, gaps and holidays against hand counts), tests/test_auth.py (form, refused dates, status endpoint), e2e checklist and journal on a phone.
